outcome.exit_reason: Rule row (TRIM to a 0% target) from run_20260902_064125. The thesis was not falsified by the market — the INPUT that selected the position was corrected. This line was opened 2026-09-01 at rank 4 on momentum 59.6, and that 59.6 came from the `3m6m_fallback`: `fetch_metrics` asked for `period="1y"`, Xetra returned 251 bars, and `_safe_return(252)` needs 253, so IQQQ.DE had no 12-1 return and fell off the officially backtested spec. The 2026-09-02 momentum fix (450d history, one shared price panel) put all 25 sectors on `12_1_52w`, and water's momentum read 38.4 — rank 7, and BELOW the profile's `min_momentum: 40`, so under the corrected input the model book would never have selected this sector at all. One trading day of holding, so nothing about the sector was learned; what was learned is about the pipeline.

assumption_resolution.note: One trading day. No refreshed study, and a 56-week rolling rho does not move in a session. The assumption asked whether struct_ai_capex_supercycle is water's real driver or a read-across label; that question is untouched by this exit and is inherited by the taxonomy, not by the position. Worth carrying forward: the same doubt now applies to grid_infrastructure_utilities, which also carries the ai_capex label and was bought with the proceeds.

Deliberately NOT read as falsified, though a reading exists and points that way. Today's BOOK RISK shows this table — sell water, buy grid + biotech — taking mean rho 0.267 -> 0.259, i.e. removing water LOWERED correlation, which is the opposite of what the entry claimed. But the measurement is confounded three ways: the sale funds two purchases in the same table, the whole universe was re-ranked by the momentum fix between entry and exit, and the holding period is one day. Calling that a falsification would be reading an artifact as evidence.

outcome.catalyst_materialized_note: Unanswerable at a one-day horizon. struct_ai_capex_supercycle neither played out nor failed to; the position was closed for a reason that has nothing to do with the catalyst.
